verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer agent gives every chat a tool approval mode. In 'auto', nothing changes on disk and no command runs until the user approves it, and Allow/Deny tool cards back this up. RBAC roles also set baseline trust levels. However, the docs state that Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines run arbitrary Python on the server, and no container or VM isolation is documented. missing for 10: container/VM sandboxing of tool execution, per-tool allow/deny policies, isolation for server-side plugins, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, risky tool runs are containable — container/VM sandboxing, tool policies, or permission modes that limit what the agent can touch
